run_reencode_replays: run the reencode_replays module to process and re-encode StarCraft II replays from an input directory to an output directory
test_replay_get_version: test the replay.get_replay_version function to detect the version of a StarCraft II replay file
review_run_config_replay_paths: review the run_config.replay_paths method to list all replay files in a given directory
summarize_controller_replay_info: summarize the controller.replay_info method to retrieve metadata about a StarCraft II replay
refactor_controller_save_replay: refactor the controller.save_replay method to capture and write re-encoded replay data to disk
